rows.abstract: Strengthens the provision on service charges collected by hotels, restaurants, lodging houses, night clubs, cocktail lounges, massage clinics, bars and similar enterprises distributed at 85% for all covered employees and 15% for management by PROVIDING FOR PENAL SANCTION IN CASE OF A VIOLATION OF THIS PROVISION BY A FINE NOT EXCEEDING TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND (P25,000.00) PESOS AND IMPRISONMENT OF NOT LESS THAN ONE (1) YEAR NOR MORE THAN FIVE (5) YEARS. rows.abstract: "Anti-Abortive Devices and Drugs Act of 1994" Prohibits the use, production, sale, distribution or dispensation of abortive devices and drugs. Defines "ABORTIVE DEVICES" as any instrument, device, material which: (a) prevents implantation of fertilized ovum; (b) creates an environment hostile to the fertilized ovum. rows.abstract: "Bank Security Act"  Requires all banks, whether government-owne d or private, to install video cameras and alarm devices connected to the nearest police. Non-compliance will mean of paying a fine of One Hundred Thousand (P100,000.00) Pesos and thebank official responsible for the omission shall be punished with prision correcional. Mandates the Philippine National Police to adopt such measures as it may deem necessary for the security of banks in consultation with the Central Bank and the Associations of Banks.
